title: JMF Survey — Multi-Tenant SNA Platform
summary: Built from scratch in PHP 8.1, MongoDB, and Vanilla JavaScript to power sociometric peer-nomination surveys and weighted N×N adjacency matrix exports across enterprise clients.
impact: ~4,000 concurrent respondents · ~3 DB round trips per survey · 5 SNA export pipelines
problem: Standard survey tools cannot disambiguate rosters of thousands of employees with headshots, capture order-weighted peer rankings, or generate square N×N directed graph matrices.
solution: Engineered a custom PHP 8.1 MVC backend with multi-tenant MongoDB isolation, browser-offloaded roster search/caching, cloud headshot storage, chunked Excel ingestion, and batch matrix exports.
